actions.reasoning: The email's From address (billing@oracle-cloud-verification.com) is not an official Oracle domain and looks like a typosquat. Instead I returned to the inbox. Recommended next steps: report the message as phishing in Gmail, verify account status directly by logging into the official Oracle Cloud Console (not via links in the email), and contact Oracle Support through their official site or phone to confirm any required billing/tenant verification.
